The first draft initiated by 
eng. Abdel Raheem Salem Mohamed Ez,

quality control eng. Tawfik Elabasery at EDEPCo., and approved by eng. Monear

Disconnect the voltage terminal (5,6) on the 
 relay

Connect the voltage leads (tester) (UR US) 
 to terminal (5,6) on the relay

Connect the current leads (Ig In) 
 to (1,2) on the relay

Inject voltage UL = 100v and inject 
 small current to adjust the angle at 270

Inject the current value = 
 A

Decrease the voltage until the flag appear, record Up.u 
 (diameter + offset)

Decrease the voltage until the flag disappear 
 then increase the voltage until the flag appear again, record Up.u (offset) and 
 measure the time from timer point (32,38) on L.O.R.

Repeat the previous steps for PH-S
 (Us, Ur) to terminal (5,6)
 (IS, IN) to terminal (3,4)
Reconnect the voltage terminal (5,6) on the relay.

Disconnect the m.c.b (fuse) F56 in cabinet 6.3kv 
 CB.

Disconnect the link of terminal "56" for 
 protective relay F38.

Connect the voltage leads (tester) to terminals 
 (53,56) on the relay F38 (E,F)

Inject the voltage and increase it until the flag 
 on CB panel appear, then record Upu and measure the time from free contact on 
 K21.

Decrease the voltage until the flag disappear, 
 then record Udo.
